ms四点，K=4，得到96维；starter.md评估命令显式覆盖成论文八点。因此“默认四点”与“评估八点”须分别记录，不能把可通过覆盖达到八点误写成默认就是八点。<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/config/env/tasks/world_pos_reaching.yaml#L11-L15">mani-centric-wbc/config/env/tasks/world_pos_reaching.yaml:11–15</a>；<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/config/env/combo_go2ARX5_reaching.yaml#L146-L151">mani-centric-wbc/config/env/combo_go2ARX5_reaching.yaml:146–151</a></p><h3>异步实时轨迹：接收、平滑、插值</h3><p><span class="tag">代码</span>EEFTraj回调将毫秒tick变秒，交给RealtimeTraj。update保留旧轨迹的前段，接上新轨迹，检查时间单调，裁去过时样本；interpolate按相邻时间计算α，位置/夹爪线性插值，旋转调用Slerp；超出首尾则保持端点。<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/real-wbc/modules/wbc_node.py#L497-L519">real-wbc/modules/wbc_node.py:497–519</a>；<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/real-wbc/modules/realtime_traj.py#L134-L164">real-wbc/modules/realtime_traj.py:134–164</a>；<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/real-wbc/modules/realtime_traj.py#L186-L241">real-wbc/modules/realtime_traj.py:186–241</a></p><div id="code-realtime_traj-202"><p class="source">[代码] RealtimeTraj.interpolate：连续查询目标位姿 · <a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/real-wbc/modules/realtime_traj.py#L202-L211">real-wbc/modules/realtime_traj.py:202–211</a> · d75c9c182d80</p><pre><code>        # There should be at least two timestamps
        idx = np.searchsorted(self.timestamps, timestamp)
        alpha = (timestamp - self.timestamps[idx - 1]) / (
            self.timestamps[idx] - self.timestamps[idx - 1]
        )
        translation = (1 - alpha) * self.translations[
            idx - 1
        ] + alpha * self.translations[idx]
        
        quaternion_wxyz = slerp_wxyz(self.quaternions_wxyz[idx-1], self.quaternions_wxyz[idx], alpha)</code></pre></div><p><span class="tag">代码</span>新旧轨迹更新平滑与轨迹内部插值是两件事：update中的四元数新旧融合直接线性混合，interpolate里的相邻旋转才调用Slerp。本文未运行检查混合后的数值性质，也不把两处统称为Slerp。<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/real-wbc/modules/realtime_traj.py#L110-L130">real-wbc/modules/realtime_traj.py:110–130</a></p><h3>固定部署版的重要差异</h3><div id="code-wbc_node-967"><p class="source">[代码] WBCNode.init_policy：当前提交把所有相对时间乘以0 · <a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/real-wbc/modules/wbc_node.py#L967-L976">real-wbc/modules/wbc_node.py:967–976</a> · d75c9c182d80</p><pre><code>        target_obs_times = [
            # float(t) * 0.05
            float(t) * 0.0
            for t in config[&quot;env&quot;][&quot;tasks&quot;][&quot;reaching&quot;][&quot;target_obs_times&quot;]
        ]
        self.target_obs_index = np.array(
            [int(np.rint(t * 200.0)) for t in target_obs_times]
        )
        print(self.target_obs_index, target_obs_times)
        self.target_obs_times = target_obs_times</code></pre></div><p class="note"><span class="tag">代码</span>这段把每个配置δ变为0.0；随后replay索引和realtime future_timestamps都来自该列表。<span class="tag infer">由代码可直接推得</span>该路径保留K个槽位，但它们指向重复的当前时刻，不能提供所配置的未来预览。<span class="tag">未核验</span>未运行，也不知道论文实验是否使用另一个内部/历史版本；不能以此判断论文实验无效或替作者解释为何保留该行。</p><p><span class="tag">代码</span>回调将adaptive_latency_matching设为true，但RealtimeTraj算出best_latency后，修改时间戳的行被注释。因此这个分支当前会计算匹配值，却未把该延迟施加到轨迹时间轴。<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/real-wbc/modules/wbc_node.py#L511-L519">real-wbc/modules/wbc_node.py:511–519</a>；<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/real-wbc/modules/realtime_traj.py#L74-L108">real-wbc/modules/realtime_traj.py:74–108</a></p></section><section id="reward"><div class="eyebrow">STAGE 03</div><h2>模块五：耦合位姿奖励与精度课程</h2><h3>设计动机</h3><p><span class="tag">论文·设计动机</span>作者发现分别奖励位置与姿态容易只在一方面精确，因此让二者在同一个指数目标里耦合；σ课程先允许探索，再提高精度要求。 <span class="source">§3.2 Rewards；§9.6 p.16 · PDF页 <a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlresearch/v270/main/assets/ha25a/ha25a.pdf#page=4">4</a>、<a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlresearch/v270/main/assets/ha25a/ha25a.pdf#page=15">15</a>、<a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlresearch/v270/main/assets/ha25a/ha25a.pdf#page=16">16</a></span></p><p class="source">本模块没有独立模块原图；核心是正文内未编号公式。本页按PDF视觉核对转写，使用本地HTML上下标，可离线读取。</p><div class="formula" id="eq-paper">[论文] r<sub>pose</sub> = exp(−(ε<sub>pos</sub>/σ<sub>pos</sub> + ε<sub>orn</sub>/σ<sub>orn</sub>))</div><p><span class="tag">论文</span>ε表示位置/姿态误差，σ是精度尺度；论文没有为该公式编号，也没有在这一公式处明确展开位置误差是距离还是平方距离。<span class="source">§3.2；§9.6 · PDF页 <a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlresearch/v270/main/assets/ha25a/ha25a.pdf#page=4">4</a>、<a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlresearch/v270/main/assets/ha25a/ha25a.pdf#page=15">15</a>、<a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlresearch/v270/main/assets/ha25a/ha25a.pdf#page=16">16</a></span></p><div id="code-task-716"><p class="source">[代码] 位置误差函数返回欧氏距离，不是平方距离 · <a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/task.py#L716-L720">mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/task.py:716–720</a> · d75c9c182d80</p><pre><code>    def get_pos_err(self, state: EnvState) -&gt; torch.Tensor:
        return torch.sum(
            torch.square(self.curr_target_pos - self.get_link_pos(state=state)),
            dim=1,
        ).sqrt()</code></pre></div><div id="code-task-768"><p class="source">[代码] 源码位置项再平方，并将两个指数相乘 · <a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/task.py#L768-L778">mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/task.py:768–778</a> · d75c9c182d80</p><pre><code>    def reward(self, state: EnvState, control: Control) -&gt; Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
        # compute reward using the current pose
        pos_reward = torch.exp(
            -(self.get_pos_err(state=state) ** 2) / self.pos_err_sigma
        )
        orn_reward = torch.exp(-self.get_orn_err(state=state) / self.orn_err_sigma)
        return {
            &quot;pos&quot;: pos_reward * self.pos_reward_scale,
            &quot;orn&quot;: orn_reward * self.orn_reward_scale,
            &quot;pose&quot;: (pos_reward * orn_reward) * self.pose_reward_scale,
        }</code></pre></div><p><span class="tag">代码</span>get_orn_err使用目标与当前旋转的相对旋转矩阵，取迹，经clip后用arccos((trace−1)/2)得到角度；单位为弧度。位置误差函数先求平方和再开根号，奖励函数随后又平方它。<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/task.py#L722-L737">mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/task.py:722–737</a></p><div class="formula" id="eq-code">[代码等价式] r<sub>pose</sub> = 4 exp(−(‖p<sub>d</sub>−p‖<sup>2</sup>/σ<sub>pos</sub> + θ/σ<sub>orn</sub>))</div><p><span class="tag">代码</span>默认独立pos_reward_scale与orn_reward_scale都是0，pose_reward_scale=4，只把耦合项作为这个任务的有效奖励；其他正则由环境另外相加。<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/config/env/tasks/world_pos_reaching.yaml#L6-L10">mani-centric-wbc/config/env/tasks/world_pos_reaching.yaml:6–10</a>；<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/env.py#L588-L611">mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/env.py:588–611</a></p><p class="note"><span class="tag">论文—代码差异</span>若把论文εpos理解为代码get_pos_err的返回值，则印式使用一次距离，代码使用距离平方；若作者本意是让εpos代表平方距离，原文此处未明确这一点。保留两者，不擅自更改公式。该差异会改变误差相同情况下奖励衰减的形状；它是否解释实验结果，本次未验证。</p><h3>课程在哪里更新</h3><ol><li><span class="tag">代码</span>step以sim_dt×smoothing_dt_multiplier更新历史误差的指数平滑值。<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/task.py#L680-L685">mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/task.py:680–685</a></li><li><span class="tag">代码</span>reset_idx计算跨环境平均历史误差，再遍历阈值→σ映射，满足阈值便更新课程等级；不是每个样本单独自适应σ。<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/task.py#L625-L642">mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/task.py:625–642</a></li><li><span class="tag">论文与代码</span>补充σpos第二项印为0.1，而默认YAML中误差阈值1.0对应σ=1.0；其余映射应逐项核对，不能假定表述无差别。<span class="source">§9.6 · PDF页 <a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlresearch/v270/main/assets/ha25a/ha25a.pdf#page=15">15</a>、<a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlresearch/v270/main/assets/ha25a/ha25a.pdf#page=16">16</a></span>；<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/config/env/tasks/world_pos_reaching.yaml#L33-L42">mani-centric-wbc/config/env/tasks/world_pos_reaching.yaml:33–42</a></li></ol><p><span class="tag">代码</span>总奖励还组合关节限制、加速度、力矩、碰撞、动作变化、身体/末端对齐、足下髋位置、质量分配等配置，并按时间尺度乘dt。本文只沿当前reaching配置核对生效链，不把文件中所有备用约束都称为本文启用。<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/config/env/combo_go2ARX5_reaching.yaml#L1-L30">mani-centric-wbc/config/env/combo_go2ARX5_reaching.yaml:1–30</a>；<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/env.py#L552-L611">mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/env.py:552–611</a></p></section><section id="actor-control"><div class="eyebrow">STAGE 03</div><h2>模块六：从观测向量到18个关节目标</h2><h3>设计动机</h3><p><span class="tag">论文·设计动机</span>用一个机器人专属控制器共同协调12个腿关节与6个臂关节，跟踪上层末端目标；作者报告MLP可在机载CPU高频运行。论文未提供选择128/64/32宽度的独立理由。 <span class="source">§3.2 Policy network architecture · PDF页 <a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlresearch/v270/main/assets/ha25a/ha25a.pdf#page=4">4</a></span></p><figure id="fig-3c"><input class="figure-zoom" id="zoom-3c" type="checkbox"><label for="zoom-3c">查看 Fig. 3c 原尺寸（可横向滚动）</label><div class="figure-viewport"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Fig.3c局部：基座、臂、腿状态与上一动作进入MLP，控制器输出臂/腿动作。"></div><figcaption>Fig. 3c · PDF p.4 · 正式版原图裁剪（未更改图内数据；勾选上方可查看原尺寸）。Fig.3c局部：基座、臂、腿状态与上一动作进入MLP，控制器输出臂/腿动作。 图源：Huy Ha、Yihuai Gao、Zipeng Fu、Jie Tan、Shuran Song，UMI-on-Legs，CoRL 2024 / PMLR 270 (2025)。© 原作者；此处用于对应方法的学术评述。<a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlresearch/v270/main/assets/ha25a/ha25a.pdf#page=4">原文与完整图注</a></figcaption></figure><p><span class="tag">代码</span>环境先按字段名字母顺序排序state_obs，再按setup/state/task/action拼接；排序后的关节位置→速度→重力→角速度与部署端排列对应。默认actor侧18个关节位置、18个速度、3维投影重力、3维角速度、18维上一动作，加9K轨迹量，合计60+9K；obs_history_len=1。图中的base state在此不是任意一份完整全局状态，需以实际配置字段为准。<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/env.py#L209-L226">mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/env.py:209–226</a>；<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/env.py#L613-L663">mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/env.py:613–663</a>；<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/config/env/obs/quadruped_state.yaml#L1-L42">mani-centric-wbc/config/env/obs/quadruped_state.yaml:1–42</a>；<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/config/env/env_base.yaml#L17">mani-centric-wbc/config/env/env_base.yaml:17</a></p><p><span class="tag">代码</span>默认actor是输入→128→64→32→18的全连接网络，前三层后有ELU；训练时ActorCritic把actor输出作为高斯均值并采样，推理act_inference直接返回均值。critic用于训练值函数，不能把其特权输入当成真机actor必需观测。<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/config/runner/alg/actor_critic/actor/default.yaml#L1-L17">mani-centric-wbc/config/runner/alg/actor_critic/actor/default.yaml:1–17</a>；<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/rsl_rl/modules/actor_critic.py#L79-L96">mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/rsl_rl/modules/actor_critic.py:79–96</a></p><div id="code-control-130"><p class="source">[代码] PositionController：关节目标经PD得到仿真力矩 · <a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/control.py#L130-L144">mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/control.py:130–144</a> · d75c9c182d80</p><pre><code>class PositionController(PDController):
    def compute_torque(
        self,
        normalized_action: torch.Tensor,
        state: EnvState,
    ):
        curr_pos = state.dof_pos.clone()
        curr_vel = state.dof_vel.clone()
        assert normalized_action.shape == curr_pos.shape
        assert curr_vel.shape == curr_pos.shape
        if normalized_action.shape[0] != self.kp.shape[0]:
            self.kp = self.kp.repeat(normalized_action.shape[0], 1)
            self.kd = self.kd.repeat(normalized_action.shape[0], 1)
        torques = self.kp * (normalized_action - curr_pos) - self.kd * curr_vel
        return super().compute_torque(torques, state)</code></pre></div><p><span class="tag infer">对应数学解释（非论文编号式）</span>q* = s⊙a+b；τ = clip(Kp⊙(q*−q)−Kd⊙q̇, ±τmax)。a为18维网络输出，s/b为scale/offset，q/q̇为实际关节位置/速度。缩放偏置先在父类__call__应用，PositionController算PD，父类compute_torque裁剪力矩。<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/control.py#L85-L106">mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/env/isaacgym/control.py:85–106</a></p><p><span
